card.name: "Shown" or "packaged" after are/is
card.fires_on: The word "shown" after "are" in radiation dosimetry sections, as in "estimates are shown in Table 1". It also fires, more weakly, on "packaged" after "is/are" and on a few other words in preparation or methods text.

modes.label: Dosimetry estimates shown
modes.description: "shown" right after "are" in radiation dose estimate statements that point to Table 1.
